name: notation-engine
description: General-purpose TypeScript + SVG music notation engine -- works for any instrument, any MusicXML source.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/notation-engine.js --format=iife --global-name=NotationEngine --sourcemap && esbuild src/soundfont/browser.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/sound-engine.js --format=iife --global-name=NotationSoundFont --sourcemap && node scripts/sync-website-bundle.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run docs:check && npm run test
